header.rule: A player who collects four of a kind says nothing and quietly puts a hand to their nose. Everyone else simply copies once they notice -- there is nothing to grab. The last player to notice takes one letter of P-I-G, and three letters put you out. The last player left wins. Hands stay at four cards throughout: everyone passes and receives at the same time.

status.waiting: You have chosen. Waiting for everyone else to choose.
status.signal: Somebody put a hand to their nose! Say you noticed -- only the last to react takes a letter.
status.signalDone: You said you noticed ({{n}} so far). Waiting for the rest.
status.roundEnd: {{name}} was last to notice and took a letter ({{word}}).
status.eliminated: You are out. The remaining players will finish it between them.

result.you: You win! You were the last one standing.

hint.pigSignal: Press "I noticed!" now -- only the last to react takes a letter.
hint.pigDiscardOdd: Let go of a rank you are not collecting.
hint.pigNoSingleton: Everything is evenly split, so break the least useful one.

tutorial.rule: **A player who collects four of a kind quietly puts a hand to their nose.** No announcement. Everyone else simply copies once they notice -- **there is nothing to grab**.
tutorial.penalty: **The last player to notice** takes one letter of P-I-G. Three letters put you out: being slow to react is the only way to lose.
tutorial.pass: **Everyone passes one card to the left at the same time.** Because you give and receive together, your hand stays at four cards. Nothing moves until every seat has chosen.
tutorial.hand: Your hand, sorted so matching ranks sit together -- you can see what you are close to at a glance.
